description:
Java port of ragleap-rag's RAG pipeline: connection pooling,
        embeddings (7 providers), vector storage on six backends
        (pgvector, FAISS, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone; Milvus
        and Pinecone are not live-verified; sparse and hybrid RRF
        search on pgvector), retrieval, generation (streaming,
        structured output, provider fallback, vision captioning),
        conversation memory, query rewriting, and a document parser
        for 27 of the Python package's 28 formats (no Parquet; legacy
        .xls needs the optional Apache POI dependency) - plus
        standalone utilities (chunking, sanitization, guardrails,
        cost tracking, evaluation scoring, structured-output
        validation, observability hooks). Independently versioned from
        the Python ragleap-rag package (see
        https://pypi.org/project/ragleap-rag/) rather than kept in
        lockstep; OCR, web, audio and video ingestion are not yet
        ported. Every module here is genuinely tested; documented
        per-class where it is not live-verified.
